title: SG-5.4 · Mocked-storage unit tests for frozen export and FrozenIDs
summary: Unit tests with mocked storage cover the export JSON format, the empty round, frozen-only inclusion and the frozen-ids reader
description: Context: the contribution package already has Exporter (backend/internal/contribution/exporter.go), the Export JSON types (export.go) and FileStore.FrozenIDs (store.go). Desired behavior: unit tests with mocked storage cover the export JSON format, the empty round, frozen-only inclusion, and the frozen-ids reader, and they pass. Expected result: `go test` in the contribution package passes with those tests present. Why: the frozen-contribution handoff to devion workseed must stay stable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the contribution package, When go test runs, Then the export format, empty round, frozen-only and FrozenIDs tests exist and pass
Given the tests, When they run, Then no real network, git or disk outside t.TempDir is used
technical_constraints: Go tests, mocked ExportSource and fake committer
definition_of_done: Tests exist and pass in the contribution package
